title: The Year Africa's Talking Nearly Closed and Built an SMS API Instead
conflicts: Founding year 2010 (HumanIPO 2012, TechPoint, Startup Guide) versus 2012 (MIT News via Phys.org): story uses 2010 for the holding company and 2012 for the API turn. API launch: HumanIPO (July 2012) says live two weeks before 25 July; Gikandi recalled 'around August 2012'; Startup Guide says APIs were settled on in 2014; story follows the contemporary report.
notes: Episode moved from the 2010 founding to the documented 2012 near-closure and turn to a developer API (arc change-of-direction, not founding-decision). Funding changed from bootstrapped to mixed because of the $20,000 Better Ventures seed. TechPoint blocks the verifier, so its Internet Archive copy is cited. The 2025 reports of Gikandi's ousting and court disputes are deliberately left out. The repeat screen flagged a same-founder match with the Max (Lagos) edition and let it through; the stories are unrelated.
